gen-dafont-lemon-milk-poppins: Wide, loose and rolling-ball friendly. Lemon Milk is at its best spreading out rounded, open letters in one pen-width line, while Poppins does its best work in tall, sturdy lowercase with no thick-thin flicker.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-fs-sentient: Sentient reads sophisticated and contemporary, with pinched, closed-in apertures. What stands out is the difference in openness: Minecraftia keeps wide gaps between curves and stems and towers high, while Sentient stays moderate and shut.
gen-dafont-neogrey-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, with generous room where curves meet stems. Down a full page it would stay crisp and unhurried, while Neogrey's skeleton outline, drawn at a fixed stroke thickness, keeps its letters standing apart.
gen-dafont-neogrey-fs-erode: Pressed-twine strokes up top, and a body whose weight gently ebbs and flows. And Erode's tall middle band against Neogrey's uniform crossbars is the whole story: strict geometry meeting editorial warmth.
gen-dafont-neogrey-fs-gambetta: Gambetta lets wide channels lead into each counter, and its stroke weight shifts noticeably without ever turning dramatic. Neogrey, traced in a single thickness, makes that moderate contrast feel livelier.
gen-dafont-neogrey-fs-neco: Authoritative and precise, Neogrey sets each rope-like letter apart from its neighbors. Neco holds a full column of text with a measured swell from hairline to stem, never pinching shut, like pressed glass.
gen-dafont-neogrey-fs-recia: Recia reads authoritative and sharp, its light modulation visible mainly up close. But Neogrey's zero-contrast lines are what make the pairing click, since the flat strokes up top give that quiet modulation something to play against.
gen-dafont-neogrey-lora: Round, twine-like letters with room to breathe. Lora does its best work with modest hairline thinning and a broad, welcoming c, while Neogrey is best at round bowls whose walls never swell.
gen-dafont-neuropol-poppins: Poppins brings tall, sturdy lowercase and loose, rope-like curves. Neuropol's digital, single-weight outline feel sits lower in the line, so the taller Poppins underneath lends both a grounded, modern footing.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-poppins: Round forms like open parentheses, classic and commanding, with no calligraphic swell. Poppins brings sturdy, tall lowercase underneath, so a little extra size on Oldtimer would help the two meet comfortably.
